note: City of McCook campground at the east edge of town on US-6/34. Closed in 2025 and open again in 2026, by reservation only (campers stayed at $20 in July and October 2026). The bathrooms and showers are out of order (city page, read 2026-11-05). One water hydrant in the centre; no water or sewer at the sites. One tent may accompany a camper; otherwise no tents. Entry has a tight turn. --Claude
